answer: Audits are recorded in ember, queued in river, and violet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 39 identities per epoch. A farm of 277 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2663 identities would post 897 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
